# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# 26.4 fixes, round 1: what starts, holds and stops an item's use on the client (MinecraftClientMixin reimplements
# startUseItem and hooks continueAttack and startAttack), and vanilla's sugar cane block.
calls net.minecraft.client.Minecraft ^startUseItem$|^handleKeybinds$|^continueAttack$|^startAttack$|^tick$
member net.minecraft.client.Minecraft rightClickDelay|missTime|UseItem|Attack|Keybind
calls net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.MultiPlayerGameMode ^useItem$|^releaseUsingItem$|^useItemOn$|^interact$|^isDestroying$|^ensureHasSentCarriedItem$|^tick$|^startPrediction$
calls net.minecraft.client.player.LocalPlayer ^startUsingItem$|^stopUsingItem$|^isUsingItem$|^onSyncedDataUpdated$|^itemUsed$|^getUsedItemHand$|^aiStep$|^tick$|^isHandsBusy$|^swing$
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity ^updatingUsingItem$|^updateUsingItem$|^startUsingItem$|^stopUsingItem$|^releaseUsingItem$|^completeUsingItem$|^onSyncedDataUpdated$|^swing$
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player ^tick$|^attack$|^canEat$
calls net.minecraft.server.network.ServerGamePacketListenerImpl ^handleUseItem$|^handleUseItemOn$|^handlePlayerAction$|^handleInteract$
calls net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayerGameMode ^useItem$|^useItemOn$
sig net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult$SwingSource
sig net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult$Success
sig net.minecraft.world.level.block.SugarCaneBlock
